title: Three Summers and One Short Patch
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：grass　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 grass 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the gardener ① cut the grass that no neighbour on the close would have described, and he said the cutting was the whole of the summer. The ② grass, meaning the blades themselves and not the moss, ran three summers and stayed undescribed in the book; grass, he said, is the only thing on a close that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of grass on that close had the same short patch beside it, and the ④ grass at the far wall, meaning the turf they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Grass, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the gardener said the describing is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the grass was the whole of the matter, meaning the lawn and not the blades. The ⑥ grass, meaning the lawn and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; grass, he said, is either something you cut or the only word that means both a blade and a lawn. He said the lawn is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ grass had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short patch. The ⑧ grass of the whole thing, the gardener wrote in November, was one close and three summers of describing; grass, he said, is either the turf at the far wall or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ grass I remember is the grass described in the plan, which closed in 1972 and is still described as the quietest on the close. ⑩ Grass, my mother said in 1974, is the only plant that improves by being described; all grass, she said, is a lawn that has agreed to look like a blade. She said the lawn was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 草；青草（指小区里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 草；青草（指那些草叶本身，与苔藓相对）
C. 固定搭配：cut the grass 修剪草坪
D. n. 草皮（指留给孩子们踩的那一块）
E. n. 草（抽象总称，指一处小区的草坪之事）
F. n. 草（指方案里写到、被丈量过的那些）
G. n. 草地；草坪（指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 草坪（抽象总称，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: cut the grass that no neighbour on the close would have described
The grass, meaning the blades themselves and not the moss
Every kind of grass on that close
the grass at the far wall
the grass was the whole of the matter
the grass had become a line in a plan
The grass of the whole thing

answers.why: cut the grass 意为“修剪草坪”，1965 年那位园丁修剪了小区里没有一位邻居肯描述的草坪。
grass 意为“草、青草”，指那些草叶本身而不是苔藓，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被描述。
grass 意为“草、青草”，指小区里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一块矮矮的草地。
grass 意为“草皮”，指最远那道墙边留给孩子们踩的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
grass 意为“草地、草坪”，指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这片草坪就是那件事的全部。
grass 意为“草坪”，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西而不是那些草，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
grass 意为“草”，指方案里写到、被丈量过的那些，到 1970 年这些成了方案里的一行。
grass 意为“草”，园丁十一月写道，整件事的草坪之事是一处小区和三个夏天的描述。
grass 意为“草”，我记得的是方案里描述过的那些，1972 年修完了，至今仍被说成小区里最安静的一片。
grass 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，草是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的植物。
